justification: Inspected `android-integration/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/integration/android/IntentResult.java`, `android-integration/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/integration/android/IntentIntegrator.java`, and `docs/apidocs/com/google/zxing/integration/android/class-use/IntentResult.html`/`package-summary.html`. `IntentResult` is a small final data holder with only 5 simple fields, 2 constructors, 5 getters, and `toString()`, and it has no outgoing dependencies on other project classes beyond a Javadoc reference to `IntentIntegrator`. Its fan-in is also minimal: the only production use found is `IntentIntegrator.parseActivityResult(...)`, and the class-use page shows no other packages or methods using `IntentResult`. That is not hub-like modularization.
